meta.name: obviously-awesome
meta.description: Define product positioning by mapping competitive alternatives, unique attributes, and best-fit customers to the right market category. Use when the user mentions "positioning", "competitive alternatives", "how to position", "market category", "positioning canvas", "repositioning", "category creation", "what category are we in", or "why prospects dont get what we do". Also trigger when launching a new product, entering a crowded market, or diagnosing why prospects dont grasp the product's value. Covers the positioning canvas and team workshops. For customer jobs analysis, see jobs-to-be-done. For go-to-market, see crossing-the-chasm.

copy.tagline: 定义产品定位，匹配市场类别与竞争优势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为产品寻找市场定位或重新定义品类
copy.tagline_en: Define product positioning by mapping competitive alternatives and market categories
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are defining or repositioning your product's market category

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你完成产品定位：分析竞争对手、独特优势、目标客户，并帮你选择最合适的市场类别。
howto.when: 当你提到“定位”、“竞争替代品”、“市场类别”等关键词，或正在推出新产品、进入拥挤市场时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析我们产品的竞争替代品有哪些？
say.note: Claude 会引导你列出客户可能使用的替代方案。

say.text: 我们的产品应该归入哪个市场类别？
say.note: Claude 会根据你的独特优势推荐最合适的市场框架。

say.text: 如何定义我们产品的最佳目标客户？
say.note: Claude 会帮你从现有客户中提炼出最匹配的特征。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through product positioning: analyzing competitive alternatives, unique attributes, best-fit customers, and choosing the right market category.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "positioning", "competitive alternatives", "market category", or when launching a new product or entering a crowded market.

say_en.text: Help me analyze our competitive alternatives.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to list alternatives customers might use.

say_en.text: Which market category should our product belong to?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend the best market frame based on your unique strengths.

say_en.text: How do we define our best-fit target customers?
